transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I... I hope I'm in the right place, and I really don't want to be a bother, but I've just been under so much stress lately. 

I'm here because of my house. I'm going through a foreclosure, and... well, everyone keeps acting like it's just standard paperwork and missed payments. But I know that's not the whole story. I hope it's okay to say this, and I don't want to sound difficult, but I know the bank, the loan servicer, and... even some people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They keep handing me all these documents, but no amount of papers they show me changes what I’ve been seeing happening for almost two years now. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm explaining things the right way for you.
Do you feel like people are working against you or plotting against you even when others don't seem to notice it?

Yes, um... exactly. I really hope you don't think badly of me for saying it. I know how it sounds, and I usually try to just keep my head down at work because I don't want to make anyone uncomfortable or seem like a difficult person. 

But... yes. Like I was trying to explain, everyone else just looks at the missed payments and thinks it's a normal situation. They don't see the connections. For almost two years now, I've watched the bank, the loan people, and even some of my coworkers... they're all coordinating this to force me out of my home. They can show me all the legal documents in the world, but it doesn't change what I know is actually happening behind the scenes. 

Is it okay that I'm telling you this? I just really want to be helpful and make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others around you don’t seem to notice, like voices or other sensations?

Oh, no... no, definitely not. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. 

I know I said earlier that I see things happening that other people don't, but I just meant... I notice the real things. Like the way my coworkers act, or the timing of the bank notices, or just connecting the dots of what they're doing. But my hearing and vision are completely normal, I promise. I don't have any strange sensations or anything like that. 

I hope that's okay? I just really don't want you to think I'm... you know, imagining things like that. I'm just very observant about my situation. Did I answer that right for you?
Have you ever had the feeling that others were plotting against you or working together to harm you, even when there was no clear evidence to support it?

Um, yes, I... I know you asked something similar just a minute ago, and I hope I didn't confuse you with my answer before. I really want to be clear. 

It's just like I was saying about the house. I don't mean to sound paranoid, and I know people might think there's no evidence because of all the foreclosure paperwork they keep showing me. But... but I know they're plotting against me. The bank, the loan servicer, the people at my job... I know they're working together to take my home. 

They say it's just missed payments, but I've been watching this happen for almost two years. I can just tell. I hope it's alright that I feel this way... I mean, I'm not trying to make things difficult for anyone, I just know what they're doing. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay.

Have these beliefs about the bank, loan servicer, and your coworkers been consistent and unchanging, even when others have tried to explain things differently or show you evidence that contradicts your concerns?

Um... yes, they really have been. I know I keep bringing up the same things, and I'm so sorry if I sound like a broken record. I really don't want to be a difficult person or seem like I'm just being stubborn when people try to reason with me. 

When my family or the lawyers sit me down and show me the foreclosure papers, I always listen politely because I don't want to upset anyone. But... well, everyone just keeps acting like it's simply paperwork and missed payments. And I have to be honest with you, no amount of papers they show me changes what I’ve been seeing for almost two years now. I just know that they've been quietly working together to push me out of my house, no matter what those documents say. 

I really hope you're not frustrated with me for not changing my mind when people show me that evidence. I just can't ignore what I know is actually happening. Is it alright that I'm sticking to that? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the most honest answers I can.
Have you ever believed something that most people would find extremely odd or impossible, even though it feels completely real to you?

Oh, no... um, no, definitely not. I would never... I mean, I know the situation with my house and the bank might sound a little intense to some people, but it's something that could actually happen in real life, right? People do shady things with real estate all the time. 

But I don't believe in anything... you know, impossible. Like aliens or mind control or anything strange like that. I'm actually a very practical person. I manage a whole sales team at the store, so I really have to stay grounded and focused on reality every day. 

I hope I'm understanding your question right? I just really want to reassure you that I don't have any bizarre thoughts like that. I'm just dealing with a very specific, real problem. Does that help answer what you were looking for?
Can you think of a time when you believed something that most people would find hard to believe or think was very strange, even though it felt completely true to you?

Oh, um... I feel terrible if I didn't answer this right just a moment ago. I know it sounds really similar to what you just asked, and I'm so sorry if I'm misunderstanding what you're looking for. I really want to be as helpful as I can. 

But... no, I honestly can't think of anything like that. I promise I don't have any strange or unbelievable thoughts. It's really just the situation with the bank and my house, which I know is a lot to take in, but it's a real-world problem, you know? I've never believed in anything impossible or... or weird. 

I hope it's okay that I don't have a good example for you? I'm really trying my best to answer everything correctly, I just want to make sure I'm doing this right.
Have you ever experienced any periods where your thoughts became very disorganized or hard to follow, even when you were trying to speak clearly?

Oh, um... no, definitely not. I'm so sorry if I've been rambling or if I'm not making sense right now. I really try my best to be clear when I'm talking to people. 

At work, I have to give directions to my team all day, so I really have to keep my thoughts organized. I don't think I've ever had a time where my thoughts were jumbled or hard to follow... at least, I really hope not! I always want to make sure I'm communicating properly. 

Have I been hard to follow today? I really hope I'm making sense to you. I just want to be sure I'm giving you the right kind of answers.
Have you noticed any difficulties in your daily life, like problems with work, relationships, or other activities, that go beyond the stress you're feeling about the situation with your house?

Oh, um... well, no, not really. I mean, I hope I'm not giving the wrong impression, but honestly, outside of the whole foreclosure thing, I think I'm doing pretty well. I really try to stay on top of everything.

I still get up every morning, go to work, supervise my team... I handle all the scheduling and deal with any customer complaints just fine. And I always make sure to take care of myself, you know? I want to present well. 

The only time things get a little... difficult... is when something comes up that seems connected to the house. Like if I get strange mail, or if the bank calls, or even if some paperwork at work seems suspicious or tied to it somehow. That's when I get a bit overwhelmed. But otherwise, I'm functioning perfectly normally, I promise. 

Does that sound okay? I just want to reassure you that I'm keeping everything else in my life completely under control.
Have you ever had any beliefs about other situations—besides the foreclosure—where you felt certain that something suspicious or harmful was happening, even if others didn’t agree with you?

Oh, um... no. I don't think so. I really hope I'm not sounding like a broken record or being difficult, but it really is just the house situation. 

I don't go around thinking people are out to get me or anything like that. I promise I'm not... well, I know some people can be very paranoid, but that's not me at all. I get along fine with my coworkers and my neighbors. It's just this one very specific, very real issue with the bank trying to take my home illegally. 

I really try to be a reasonable person. I hope you can see that? I just wouldn't want you to think I'm making up problems everywhere I look, because I'm definitely not doing that. Is that the kind of answer you were looking for?
